name: miller
description: Swiss Army chainsaw for CSV, TSV, JSON data - like awk, sed, cut, join, sort for name-indexed data with 40+ built-in processing verbs

mlr.description: Powerful data processing tool combining awk, sed, cut, join, sort functionality for CSV, TSV, JSON with 40+ built-in verbs
mlr.usage:
mlr --csv cut -f name,age data.csv
mlr --icsv --ojson cat data.csv
mlr --csv stats1 -a sum -f sales data.csv
mlr --csv filter '$age > 25' people.csv
mlr --csv put '$bonus = $salary * 0.1' employees.csv
